lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa ghar 2 mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, Second House, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸੁਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa mitr sut naal bhaaee ||
lines.translation: Some form alliances with friends, children and siblings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਕੁੜਮ ਸਕੇ ਨਾਲਿ ਜਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa kuRam sake naal javaaee ||
lines.translation: Some form alliances with in-laws and relatives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਿਕਦਾਰ ਚਉਧਰੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kis hee dhaRaa keeaa sikadaar chaudharee naal aapanai suaaee ||
lines.translation: Some form alliances with chiefs and leaders for their own selfish motives.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਾਰਾ ਧੜਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: hamaaraa dhaRaa har rahiaa samaaee ||1||
lines.translation: My alliance is with the Lord, who is pervading everywhere. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham har siu dhaRaa keeaa meree har tek ||
lines.translation: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; the Lord is my only support.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਖੁ ਧੜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਸੰਖ ਅਨੇਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai har bin pakh dhaRaa avar na koee hau har gun gaavaa asa(n)kh anek ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Other than the Lord, I have no other faction or alliance; I sing of the countless and endless Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੑ ਸਿਉ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੇ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinh siu dhaRe karahi se jaahi ||
lines.translation: Those with whom you form alliances, shall perish.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੁ ਧੜੇ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੋਤਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhooth dhaRe kar pachhotaahi ||
lines.translation: Making false alliances, the mortals repent and regret in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਖੋਟੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: thir na rahahi man khot kamaahi ||
lines.translation: Those who practice falsehood shall not last.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਧੜਾ ਕੀਆ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ham har siu dhaRaa keeaa jis kaa koee samarath naahi ||2||
lines.translation: I have formed my alliance with the Lord; there is no one more powerful than Him. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਸਭਿ ਧੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: eh sabh dhaRe maaiaa moh pasaaree ||
lines.translation: All these alliances are mere extensions of the love of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲੂਝਹਿ ਗਾਵਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kau loojhahi gaavaaree ||
lines.translation: Only fools argue over Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਜੂਐ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: janam marahi jooai baajee haaree ||
lines.translation: They are born, and they die, and they lose the game of life in the gamble.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: hamarai har dhaRaa j halat palat sabh savaaree ||3||
lines.translation: My alliance is with the Lord, who embellishes all, in this world and the next. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਧੜੇ ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਝਗੜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kalijug mahi dhaRe pa(n)ch chor jhagaRaae ||
lines.translation: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the five thieves instigate alliances and conflicts.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ਵਧਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu abhimaan vadhaae ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit have increased.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa kare tis satasa(n)g milaae ||
lines.translation: One who is blessed by the Lord's Grace, joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹ ਧੜੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: hamaraa har dhaRaa jin eh dhaRe sabh gavaae ||4||
lines.translation: My alliance is with the Lord, who has destroyed all these alliances. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਥਿਆ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਧੜੇ ਬਹਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: mithiaa doojaa bhaau dhaRe bahi paavai ||
lines.translation: In the false love of duality, people sit and form alliances.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਾਇਆ ਛਿਦ੍ਰੁ ਅਟਕਲੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: paraaiaa chhidr atakalai aapanaa aha(n)kaar vadhaavai ||
lines.translation: They complain about other peoples' faults, while their own self-conceit only increases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸਾ ਬੀਜੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaisaa beejai taisaa khaavai ||
lines.translation: As they plant, so shall they harvest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਧੜਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੫॥੨॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kaa har dhaRaa dharam sabh srisat jin aavai ||5||2||54||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak has joined the Lord's alliance of Dharma, which shall conquer the whole world. ||5||2||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hiradai sun sun man a(n)mrit bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Constantly listening to the Ambrosial Gurbani in the heart, it becomes pleasing to the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gurabaanee har alakh lakhaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Through Gurbani, the Incomprehensible Lord is comprehended. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਭੈਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam sunahu meree bhainaa ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, listen to the Naam, the Name of the Lord, O my sisters.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko rav rahiaa ghat a(n)tar mukh bolahu gur a(n)mrit bainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The One Lord is pervading and permeating deep within the heart; with your mouth, recite the Ambrosial Hymns of the Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai man tan prem mahaa bairaag ||
lines.translation: My mind and body are filled with divine love, and great sadness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਡਭਾਗੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: satigur purakh paaiaa vadabhaag ||2||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, I have obtained the True Guru, the Primal Being. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: doojai bhaai bhavahi bikh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the love of duality, the mortals wander through poisonous Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bhaagaheen nahee satigur paaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: The unfortunate ones do not meet the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਪੀਆਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit har ras har aap peeaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself inspires us to drink in the Lord's Ambrosial Elixir.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur poorai naanak har paaiaa ||4||3||55||
lines.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, O Nanak, the Lord is obtained. ||4||3||55||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: merai man tan prem naam aadhaar ||
lines.translation: The Love of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the Support of my mind and body.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀ ਨਾਮੋ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naam japee naamo sukh saar ||1||
lines.translation: I chant the Naam; the Naam is the essence of peace. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਜਨ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam japahu mere saajan sainaa ||
lines.translation: So chant the Naam, O my friends and companions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੈਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa mai avar na koee vadai bhaag guramukh har lainaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, there is nothing else for me. By great good fortune, as Gurmukh, I have received the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਹੀ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa nahee jeeviaa jaai ||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, I cannot live.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: vadai bhaag guramukh har paai ||2||
lines.translation: By great good fortune, the Gurmukhs obtain the Naam. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮਹੀਨ ਕਾਲਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: naamaheen kaalakh mukh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Those who lack the Naam have their faces rubbed in the dirt of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naam binaa dhrig dhrig jeevaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Without the Naam, cursed, cursed are their lives. ||3||
